pages.text: These artifacts are in the Osiris Pharaoh’s loot pool. Use four matching Torches of Osiris to target it. An untuned ritual can also drop them.
Use this hoe on Fertile Soil to bless the tilled ground. Blessed soil improves crop growth.
Wear this amulet in a Curios necklace slot. It preserves inventory and Curios through death at the cost of some of the amulet’s durability. You still die and respawn.
